source: apple-importer; records what the Apple app does today, NOT a target
notes: A whole-page capture from a Gemini link: no speaker labels at all, the first line is the word 'Gemini', and the conversation mentions Claude.

This reproduces the mechanism behind the real one-message captures. Apple: the first line is a bare-name marker, so the whole page becomes ONE message of role assistant, and the keyword scan finds 'claude' before 'gemini', so the session is labelled Claude although the link is a Gemini link. The web app takes the provider from the link host, does not honour a lone bare name, and keeps the page as one message of role unknown for the user to review. Nothing in this text allows a split.

messages.text:
Conversation with Gemini
How often should I water tomato seedlings?
Water when the top centimetre of soil is dry. Check it with a fingertip every morning.
A neighbour says Claude told her to mist them instead.
Misting alone is rarely enough for seedlings. Water the soil, not the leaves.
